interpretationDescription: Natural, indirect, misspelled and follow-up wording. Checked against the backend MyHrQuestionInterpreter (MyHrQuestionInterpreterTest) and the frontend interpretWaviQuestion (waviIntents.test.js). The routed question is the interpretation, or the question itself when there is none; 'earlier' are the user's own previous questions. kind/subject/aspect/field: its own-record classification (kind null: none). canonical: the exact routed question. unsupported: a personal field Wavi does not show. clarify: a status question naming no record.
